scope: held half of the phase-1 patient and exact-signal components; retrospective development, not an independent test
reference_semantics: unchanged SPH V1 frozen endpoint mappings; absent compatible statement is not absence of clinical disease
risk_definition: per-ECG mean binary error over that profile's compatible endpoints; risk is not top-1 error

bootstrap.unit: patient components linked by exact signal
bootstrap.scope: fixed-policy abstention and coverage, risk, baseline and accepted endpoint-macro F1, their paired difference and AURC; not uncertainty of threshold fitting
